bull_bear.body: Merger with Piramal Finance by Sept 2025 to consolidate lending entities; Use of INR9,000cr cash for growth and potential buybacks; Legacy asset runoff; Exit from high-RWA investments (Shriram Life/General) to free up capital
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: MSME unsecured open-market origination deterioration; Used car refinance risk (self-employed segment); Prepayment charge rule change from Jan 2026 impacting LAP income; Regulatory delays in merger; Capital adequacy pressure if growth outpaces profit
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, data-driven, and agile; Emphasis on tactical adjustments over rigid strategy; Strong focus on tech, discipline, and merger execution; Transparent on risks and proactive in disbursement cuts
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: ECL rebalancing (INR105cr release) is a one-time accounting boost, not fundamental improvement; 50% of Legacy book costs will persist post-merger due to staff absorption; Mutual fund lending is a hidden secular growth vector; Gen AI is driving 15-20% productivity gains in risk and ops
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways
